intro: In Stormwind's Old Town, veteran armor merchant Osric Strang supplies weary travelers and Alliance defenders with sturdy gear. His shop, Limited Immunity, specializes in heavy mail and plate armor, along with shields.

p: Osric Strang runs Limited Immunity, where fighters find heavy armor and shields. He also helps arriving couriers who need a point of contact in the capital, including those coming from nearby settlements such as Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
